title: SS Tibet expedition of 1938
summary: Peter Levenda tells of SS Tibet expedition of 1938, about 1938 at Tibet, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and I'm looking at the Tibet expedition of 1938, the SS Tibet expedition of 1938.
as well. They even sent people to Tibet to like get the Tibetan scriptures.
tellings.difference: Gives no year and says the aim was to get Tibetan scriptures, adding Mount Kailash.
tellings.link_reason: The Nazi/SS expedition to Tibet in the 1930s, the same program as the 1938 SS Tibet expedition.

plain: A writer and researcher named Peter Levenda says he was going through captured German documents on microfilm and looking at the 1938 Tibet expedition run by the SS, Nazi Germany's elite organisation under Heinrich Himmler. He tells it because it would show the Nazi leadership sending people to Tibet in search of something hidden or ancient.
